name: Nonogram sudoku 6x6
description:
Fill the 6×6 grid with numbers 1 to 6 so that:
Each number appears exactly once per row and once per column (Latin square rule).
Numbers outside the grid indicate groups of consecutive even numbers (2, 4, 6) in that row or column. (For example, a clue "2 1" means a group of 2 even numbers followed later by a single even number.)
Groups of even numbers are separated by at least one odd number (1, 3, 5).
